BETA Close X Bellway PLC has announced the purchase of 47,341 ordinary shares between July 13 and July 17, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The volume-weighted average price for these shares was 1,927.28 pence, with the highest price paid being 1,987.00 pence and the lowest at 1,860.00 pence. These repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing the total number of ordinary shares in issue to 113,060,864. This action is consistent with the company's previously announced buyback program. Disclaimer* Bellway PLC 20 July 2026 Bellway p.l.c. Transaction in Own Shares 20 July 2026 Bellway p.l.c. ('Bellway' or the 'Group') announces that, in accordance with the terms of the share buyback programme (the 'Buyback Programme') announced on 14 October 2025 and the terms of the Second Tranche announced on 2 April 2026, from 13 July 2026 up to and including 17 July 2026 the Group purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 12.5 pence each (the Ordinary Shares') through Deutsche Bank AG. Date Number of shares purchased Highest price paid (GBp) Lowest price paid (GBp) Volume weighted average price (GBp) Trading venue 13 July 2026 10,300 1,920.00 1,902.00 1,913.09 XLON 14 July 2026 10,500 1,903.00 1,860.00 1,878.87 XLON 15 July 2026 8,164 1,930.00 1,893.00 1,916.33 XLON 16 July 2026 8,377 1,965.00 1,945.00 1,960.56 XLON 17 July 2026 10,000 1,987.00 1,962.00 1,973.77 XLON The purchased Ordinary Shares will be cancelled. Since the announcement of the Second Tranche of the Buyback Programme on 2 April 2026, Bellway has purchased 3,282,483 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation. Bellway has now purchased 6,240,799 Ordinary Shares under the first and second tranche (to date) in aggregate for cancellation under the Buyback Programme. Following settlement of the above purchases and cancellation of the purchased ordinary shares, the Group's total number of ordinary shares in issue shall be 113,060,864 ordinary shares.
